title: SDD Closure Actuals Record
description: Single closure actuals notebook written only by sdd-archive at change closure. Read by roadmap-maker and sdd-time-estimation for calibration. Eliminates dual-notebook drift (seam S5).

change_name.description: Kebab-case change slug, inherited from entry contract.

project.description: Project identifier, matching the entry contract.

implementation_hours.description: Actual hours spent in implementation (apply phase).

review_gate_hours.description: Actual hours spent in review gates (verify phase + PR review).

total_wall_clock_hours.description: Total elapsed wall-clock hours from first apply to archive.

post_review_fix_hours.description: Hours spent on post-review fixes after the initial verify pass.

approval_decision.description: Final approval outcome (e.g. approved, approved-with-notes, rejected).

scope_drift_notes.description: Free-text notes on any scope changes discovered during implementation.

variance_vs_plan.description: Summary of actual vs planned hours variance and contributing factors.
